source_citation: Kuijpers,A.,Werner,F.,Rumohr,J.(1993),Sandwaves and other large-scale bedforms as indicators of non-tidal surge currents in the Skagerrak off Northern Denmark,Marine Geology111,209-221.
source_locator: Publisher abstract: side-scan sonar bedform depth distribution and interpretation of active Jutland-associated bottom flow.
source_access: Primary publisher abstract reviewed through indexed publisher text; direct page request returned403. Full paper, figures and raw survey data not acquired or reviewed.
source_factual_summary: Sonar surveys off Hanstholm and Hirtshals report widespread transverse and longitudinal bedforms at water depths down to70m. Authors interpret the bedforms as active and associate strong local bottom flow with the Jutland Current.

records.geographic_scope: Combined author-reported sonar survey context off Hanstholm and Hirtshals, northern Denmark; no site-specific70m assignment or mapped footprint reconstructed.

qualifications: This is one indirect regional depth-context reference for an author-interpreted current-associated bedform field, not a direct current-depth observation or independent measurement at each named site.
The70m coordinate describes water depth at bedforms; it is neither bedform height nor current thickness, lower velocity contour, current bottom or a surface-connected penetration bound.

The abstract associates local bottom flow with Jutland but does not give a colocated vertical velocity profile, axis, survey dates, source depth datum or current-water-mass membership at every bedform.
Do not rank this value as physical current depth or combine it with the22m area-mean water-mass statistic or episodic10-15m GBW layer as a range, seasonal change or paired volume geometry.
No figure digitization, full-paper inspection, raw data retrieval, tide removal or new independent observations are claimed.
